name: Scholomance: the keyless Brazier of the Herald accepts the opening spell and summons Kirtonos (#11923)
contract: Issue #11923: using Blood of Innocents (13523) on the Brazier of the Herald (gameobject 175564, type BUTTON) said Invalid target and Kirtonos the Herald (10506) never came. #11458 removed the brazier's lock 1179 (Data1 0), but a client that cached the lock still uses the item, which casts Opening 3366 (SPELL_EFFECT_OPEN_LOCK) at the brazier. A lockless gameobject other than a door refused that spell with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS (the door case was #6816). Expected: Opening on the lockless brazier is not refused, activates it, and its SmartAI sets instance data 0, which summons Kirtonos.
